solutions.question: 1(a)
solutions.latex: Number of periods $n = 3 \times 2 = 6$; rate per period $r = \dfrac{4\%}{2} = 2\%$. The table value for 6 periods at 2% is $1.126$. Answer: C.

solutions.question: 1(c)
solutions.marks_breakdown: 1: adjusting to compounding period and correct substitution; 2: correct solution

solutions.question: 2(a)
solutions.latex: Answer: C (declining balance gives exponential decay).

solutions.question: 2(b)
solutions.latex:
Time difference $= 7$ hrs.

New York time of arrival $= 8$ pm Wednesday.

$\therefore$ Athens time of arrival $= 3$ am Thursday.
solutions.marks_breakdown: 1: time difference; 1: New York arrival time (must have am/pm); 1: Athens arrival time and day (must have am/pm)

solutions.question: 3(a)
solutions.latex:
15th to 31st October is 17 days; 1st to 13th November is interest free.

$$FV = 1405.95\left(1 + \dfrac{12.8\%}{365}\right)^{17} = \$1414.36$$ Answer: B.

solutions.question: 3(b)
solutions.latex:
Profit $=$ Income $-$ Cost $= 6n - (2n + 110)$

$P = 4n - 110$

When $n = 63$, $P = \$142$.

$\therefore$ Profit of \$142.
